# Julian Tracht

> Freelance full-stack developer and project manager from Schwarzenbek near Hamburg, Germany. Works through Tracht Digital Solutions on custom software, workflow digitalization, automation and integrations, customer portals, websites and online shops. German site at /, English at /en/.

Focus technologies: C# and .NET, TypeScript, Vue, React, REST APIs, Shopware 6, WooCommerce, Magento 2, PIM and ERP integrations. Contact: kontakt@tracht-digital.de or https://tracht-digital.de/#contact. No rates or availability are published on this site.

## Services (Tracht Digital Solutions)

- [Digitalizing workflows](https://tracht-digital.de/en/services/process-optimization): no more double data entry, fewer manual mistakes
- [Automation & integrations](https://tracht-digital.de/en/services/tailored-solutions): scripts take over repetitive manual work, programs work together
- [Customer portals & admin panels](https://tracht-digital.de/en/services/customer-portals): one place for projects, customers and documents
- [Websites & online shops](https://tracht-digital.de/en/services/web-presence): custom sites that are found on Google and in AI answers
- [Consulting & planning](https://tracht-digital.de/en/services/consulting-planning): a clear starting point with known costs

## Time savings

Saved hours per year = minutes per task × tasks per week × share automated × 46 working weeks. Example: 10 minutes, 25 times a week, 70 % automated ≈ 134 hours per year (≈ 11 hours per month). This is an example calculation, not a measured result.
